raw_text: A persistent cyber intrusion was detected in the administrative network of the Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant in Tamil Nadu, with the malware attributed to a variant used by the Lazarus Group, a threat actor linked to North Korea. The malware targeted the plant's HR and procurement systems. NPCIL confirmed that operational technology networks remained air-gapped and unaffected. The Department of Atomic Energy has ordered a comprehensive security audit across all nuclear installations in the country.
clean_text: Lazarus Group malware detected at Kudankulam admin network targeting HR and procurement. OT air-gapped. DAE ordered comprehensive audit of all nuclear installations.
